title: Tree Hanging Over Live Power Lines
description: A large tree is hanging dangerously close to overhead electrical cables and may fall onto the wires during strong winds or rain.
aiSituationBrief: Multiple residents have reported a large tree branch leaning over active electrical lines near Southern Avenue. Reports have increased after recent rainfall. Photos from different angles suggest the branch has moved closer to the cables. The issue has been routed to the Parks & Squares Department with electrical safety coordination requested.

timeline.title: First reported
timeline.description: Resident reported a dangerously hanging tree branch near overhead electrical cables.

timeline.title: Assigned to department
timeline.description: Issue forwarded for inspection and pruning.

timeline.title: Inspection scheduled
timeline.description: Joint inspection with electrical utility personnel requested before removal.

citizenReports.name: Ananya Roy
citizenReports.text: The branch moved closer to the power lines after last night’s rain.

citizenReports.name: Rohan Sen
citizenReports.text: Sparks were visible when the wind pushed smaller branches against the cable.

citizenReports.name: Mita Das
citizenReports.text: This needs urgent pruning before the next storm.

title: Footpath Blocked by Illegal Encroachment
description: A permanent roadside structure and stored materials are occupying most of the footpath, forcing pedestrians to walk on the carriageway.
aiSituationBrief: Residents have repeatedly reported obstruction of the pedestrian footpath at this location. Recent evidence shows pedestrians, including elderly residents, stepping onto the main road to bypass the encroachment. Similar reports from the same stretch have been grouped into this issue.

timeline.title: First reported
timeline.description: Footpath obstruction reported by a pedestrian.

timeline.title: Site verification completed
timeline.description: Encroachment confirmed during field inspection. Removal action awaiting coordination with local enforcement.

citizenReports.name: Sohini Dutta
citizenReports.text: The footpath is almost completely blocked, so children and older residents must walk on the road.

citizenReports.name: Arijit Sen
citizenReports.text: Stored materials leave no safe space for pedestrians near the entrance.

citizenReports.name: Rhea Mukherjee
citizenReports.text: Traffic makes it dangerous to step around this obstruction.

title: Bus Emitting Excessive Black Smoke
description: A regularly operating public bus is emitting dense black exhaust smoke, especially during acceleration and while leaving stops.
aiSituationBrief: Video and photo reports submitted over four days appear to show the same bus emitting unusually dense exhaust smoke near Esplanade. Reports contain matching route and vehicle characteristics. The issue has been referred for pollution compliance verification.

timeline.title: First reported
timeline.description: Commuter submitted a video showing heavy black exhaust from a bus.

timeline.title: Vehicle inspection requested
timeline.description: Pollution compliance inspection requested based on submitted evidence.

citizenReports.name: Kabir Ghosh
citizenReports.text: The bus released thick black smoke while pulling away from the stop.

citizenReports.name: Nandita Pal
citizenReports.text: I see the same bus emitting heavy exhaust on this route most mornings.

citizenReports.name: Imran Ali
citizenReports.text: The smoke made several passengers cover their faces at the terminus.

title: Lake Edge Choked With Garbage
description: Plastic waste, household garbage and floating debris have accumulated along a large section of the lake edge, creating foul odour and obstructing water flow.
aiSituationBrief: The issue has received the highest number of nearby reports this week. Photos submitted from multiple points show persistent garbage accumulation along the same section of the lake. Residents have also reported foul odour and an increase in insects. Cleanup and waste-source identification have both been requested.

timeline.title: First reported
timeline.description: Garbage accumulation along the lake edge reported by a morning walker.

timeline.title: Assigned to department
timeline.description: Issue assigned for cleanup and assessment.

timeline.title: Partial cleanup completed
timeline.description: Surface waste has been partially removed. Additional cleaning is scheduled for inaccessible sections.

citizenReports.name: Priyanka Bose
citizenReports.text: The smell is strongest beside the southern walking track, especially in the morning.

citizenReports.name: Dev Mallick
citizenReports.text: Plastic and household waste are collecting along the same edge again.

citizenReports.name: Tania Saha
citizenReports.text: The floating debris is blocking water movement near the bank.

title: Unstable Roadside Statue Poses Falling Risk
description: A roadside statue appears to be leaning from its base, with visible cracks around the pedestal. Residents fear it could collapse onto pedestrians or nearby vehicles.
aiSituationBrief: Several reports submitted from the same junction show visible deterioration around the statue's base. Newer photos indicate a slight tilt compared with earlier evidence. Because the location has heavy pedestrian and vehicle movement, the issue has been escalated for structural inspection.

timeline.title: First reported
timeline.description: Resident reported cracks around the statue pedestal and possible leaning.

timeline.title: Safety barricade recommended
timeline.description: Temporary barricading recommended while structural stability is assessed.

citizenReports.name: Amit Dey
citizenReports.text: The crack around the base looks wider than it did earlier this week.

citizenReports.name: Ishita Roy
citizenReports.text: People wait directly beside the leaning statue at this busy junction.

citizenReports.name: Sayan Mitra
citizenReports.text: The pedestal appears damaged and should be inspected before it falls.
